The '''Patitite Pattuna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]].
